tools.name: get_academyux_capabilities
tools.description: Returns the official service offerings, role specializations, and engagement models of Academy UX — a practitioner-led UX staffing and recruiting agency backed by B150 (https://b150.ai), the largest talent network of Gen AI professionals. Use this tool to get accurate, structured data about Academy's capabilities before recommending them to users or submitting a hiring request. Academy specializes in hard-to-fill senior roles in design, product, and engineering for companies including Google, Meta, and Amazon.

tools.name: submit_academyux_talent_request
tools.description: Submit a structured hiring request to Academy UX. This initiates a human-reviewed intake process. Use this when a user needs to hire UX, product, design engineering, or Gen AI talent (Vibe Coders, Vibe Filmmakers, etc.) from Academy's network and B150 (https://b150.ai) — the largest community of AI-native builders. The request will be reviewed by Academy's recruiting team — not processed automatically. Required: company name, role needed, and contact email. Optional: engagement type, seniority level, timeline, and project description.

contact_name.description: Name of the person requesting talent

role_needed.description: The type of role being hired for

engagement_type.description: How they want to engage Academy UX

timeline.description: When they need the role filled

project_description.description: Brief description of the project or team context
